UUI11-S5.name: generated:UUI11-S5
UUI11-S5.description:
Backend only ever holds a valid, closed set of states the screen can mirror

risk: ui_backend_disagreement (priority P1)
purpose: Establish the ground truth AC-3 depends on: every persisted run holds exactly one state from the known WorkflowState enum and none is null/blank, so any state the screen displays can be checked against a real backend value.
requirement: U-UI-11: the screen never shows a state the backend does not currently hold
product principle: known_vs_inferred
rationale: AC-3 is a screen-vs-backend agreement claim. Since the exception screen is static output with no served route at 8001, the executable half of the invariant is: the backend's own state column is well-formed and drawn only from the enum the render layer maps. A null/foreign state would mean the screen is showing something the backend cannot justify.
